dedupe_keys.name: comision nacional de los mercados y la competencia electricity datasets

description: Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia. Coverage: Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia. The listing groups 64 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Retribución anual total recibida por los productores de energía eléctr; Evolución anual de energía eléctrica a partir de las fuentes de energí; Evolución mensual de energía eléctrica a partir de las fuentes de ener; Evolución anual de la producción de energía eléctrica a partir de fuen. Formats seen: XML, JSON, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.cnmc.es/condiciones-de-uso). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
